title: CustomCollectionMetadata
description: Canonical metadata template for A5 custom dataset collection runs across all 12 categories.

sample_id.description: Canonical unique primary key across all modalities (e.g. EXEC_RUN-002)

os.description: Target guest operating system during execution

execution_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of execution or acquisition

source_reference.description: Sample hash (SHA-256), framework payload ID, or baseline test identifier

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete raw evidence package

memory_dump.description: Indicates whether a full volatile memory dump was acquired

sysmon_available.description: Indicates whether Sysmon process and network event telemetry was captured

notes.description: Operational notes, execution parameters, and forensic observations
